basic_info.description:
KEY FEATURES
Bedrooms: 2 Bed
Bathrooms: 1.5 Bath
Lease Duration: 1-Year
Laundry: Washer and dryer in garage
Property Type: Apartment
DESCRIPTION

Remodeled 2 BD/ 1.5 BA within 2 unit building and with a private backyard. In close proximity to restaurants, retail, public transit, Lafayette Park, Union Street, Fillmore Street, and much more.

UNIT FEATURES
-Hardwood floors
-Remodeled kitchen with stainless steel appliances
-The kitchen features a refrigerator, gas range, dishwasher, microwave
-Large living room
-2 spacious bedrooms
-1.5 bathrooms with period details
-Private backyard

ADDITIONAL INFO

-1-year lease required
-No animals other than those required by law
-1 car parking included in rent
-No smoking
-Owner pays for water and garbage
-Lots of natural light
